cases.name: finished_lists_the_last_day_seen_or_not
cases.description: Finished (#10922) lists the tasks handed out (by this or, in the main conversation, any conversation) that finished in the last 24 hours, seen or not, newest finished first. A task finished when the To-dos triage says: its close (t-new, t-seen, t-other, t-almost), its accepting review (t-accepted), else its last move for a finished turn the owner has already seen (t-read, which the To-dos page files under Done). Seeing a task changes only whether it is new (finished_new: the To-dos page's Just finished). Exactly 24 hours ago is out (t-day), one second less is in (t-almost); older ones (t-old), a to-do made by hand (t-by-hand) and an old failed start (t-failed) are not listed. Finished rows are not open work. A seen reply alone is still an unfinished stop and needs follow-up after an hour.
